terminal_reason: The response-independent database dictionary proves that both candidate biological response tables require media.csv to recover monitoring visit and capture time: annotations.fk_mediaid -> media.pk_mediaid; modeloutputs.fk_mediaid -> media.pk_mediaid; media.fk_visitid -> visits.pk_visitid; visits.fk_locationid -> locations.pk_locationid. Because media.csv was prospectively classified as response-bearing and forbidden at Gate0, opening it to repair response-to-site/time linkage is not admissible. The fresh endpoint is therefore stopped without opening any response-bearing payload.

response_independent_observations.location_geometry_note: Exact lat/long were withheld in the public table, while 13 monitoring rows expose long_min/long_max/lat_min/lat_max bounding boxes; one additional non-monitoring/aggregate row lacks those public bounds. This was not the terminal reason because the response linkage gate failed first.

next_mainline_action: Select another genuinely fresh heterogeneous ecosystem whose response table can be mapped to a response-independent site/time registry without opening a response-bearing linkage table.
